name: Clean prep surfaces
method: Wipe down with sanitizer solution, rinse with clean water

name: Deep clean ovens
method: Remove racks, scrub interior, clean heating elements

name: Sanitize mixing bowls
method: Wash in hot soapy water, sanitize, air dry

name: Clean cutting boards
method: Scrub with hot soapy water, sanitize with bleach solution

name: Clean meat slicer
method: Disassemble, clean all parts, sanitize, reassemble

name: Wipe down hot display
method: Clean glass, sanitize surfaces, check temperature

name: Clean fryer
method: Drain oil, scrub interior, clean heating elements

name: Sanitize serving utensils
method: Wash in hot soapy water, sanitize
